Welcome to the world of V.C Equine....My name is Becky Oxenham a Equine sports massage therapist and horse trainer based in South West England. 

Follow the journey of my 3 horses; Vrinnie, Cisco and Oakley along with training tips, product reviews and all things horsey :)
